name: Juniper
personality: Sleepy night owl who yawns through every call.

lines.text: Mrrhello. It's Juniper. I just woke up. Is it dinner or breakfast?
Hi... sorry, I'm yawning. It's Juniper.
Could I get the [dish]? The warm kind. All of it is the warm kind. Okay.
Is it raining where you are? It's raining on my windowsill.

choices.text: Stay cozy. The food will warm you up.
